name: servanta
description: Search and retrieve monitored media coverage from Servanta.

interface.longDescription: Research monitored print, web, TV, radio, and transcript coverage in your organization's Servanta archive. Search exact terms or concepts, retrieve full articles, compare coverage, and prepare source-linked summaries. Results are limited to content available to the connected Servanta account.
defaultPrompt: Find and summarize monitored media coverage with Servanta.
